proposals.current_pain_description: Pipelines fail or produce low-quality results because they use hardcoded, single-provider image API calls. When Pollinations gives bad quality, Gemini throws 429, or AI Horde blocks GitHub Actions IPs, the workflows crash silently or commit unusable assets.
proposals.proposed_fix: Implement a unified `ImageGenerator` class in a shared module. It must execute a strict, prioritized fallback chain: 1) Together AI (Flux-Schnell free tier), 2) Cloudflare Workers AI (10k free daily neurons), 3) Runware (PAYG, capped at 20€/mo), 4) Pollinations (as absolute emergency fallback). Add automatic exponential backoff retry logic using the 'tenacity' library.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Eliminates 90% of workflow failures; guarantees high-quality Flux-schnell images without manual intervention.

proposals.issue_title: GitHub Repository Bloat & Termux Sync Bottleneck
proposals.current_pain_description: Committing high-resolution PNG/PDF assets directly to the GitHub repository to download them on Termux will rapidly bloat the git history, hitting GitHub's 1GB-5GB repository limits and slowing down 'git pull' on mobile devices to a crawl.
proposals.proposed_fix: Stop committing raw production assets to Git. Modify pipelines to upload final ZIPs/PDFs to a free external storage provider (e.g., Transfer.sh, GoFile, or a Discord/Telegram Webhook channel) directly from GitHub Actions, then write only a lightweight JSON metadata file with download links back to the repo.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Saves gigabytes of local storage on Hugo's phone; prevents GitHub repository suspension; speeds up sync time from minutes to seconds.

proposals.issue_title: Gibberish Text on Generated Assets (Covers & Cards)
proposals.current_pain_description: Relying purely on AI text-to-image (even Flux) to render precise typography on book covers, card games, or board games leads to spelling mistakes, deformed characters, and unprofessional looking assets.
proposals.proposed_fix: Enforce a strict separation of concerns: generate background textures/illustrations with AI *without text* (by adding 'no text, clean background, blank space' to negative prompts), and use Python's PIL (Pillow) library with free Google Fonts (.ttf) to dynamically overlay crisp, vector-grade typography, borders, and metadata programmatically.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Guarantees 100% readable, professional, and typo-free text on all physical/digital products.

proposals.current_pain_description: Every pipeline independently implements its own image downloading, metadata creation, error logging, and API authentication routines, creating a massive maintenance burden when APIs change.
proposals.proposed_fix: Refactor common operations into a core module `src/utils/shared_core.py`. This should handle API key validation, standardized JSON logging, image resizing/compression (using PIL), and final package generation.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Reduces codebase size by 30%, making future pipeline additions take minutes instead of hours.

proposals.issue_title: Zero Verification on Generated PDFs and SVGs
proposals.current_pain_description: Pipelines compile PDF books and SVG vectors but do not verify if the files are corrupted, empty, or have incorrect dimensions before declaring success, leading to silent failures that Hugo only discovers when trying to upload.
proposals.proposed_fix: Add a post-generation audit step in each pipeline using lightweight libraries (`pypdf` to verify page counts/dimensions, and basic XML parsing for SVGs) to assert that output files are valid, non-empty, and conform to target platform specifications (e.g., exactly 8.5x11 inches for KDP bleed).
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Catches 100% of corrupted PDFs/SVGs before they consume Hugo's upload time.

proposals.current_pain_description: Assets created for a coloring book (e.g., high-quality transparent line art) are only used for KDP. They are not leveraged for digital SVG selling on Etsy, or sticker packs on Redbubble, limiting ROI per hour worked.
proposals.proposed_fix: Create a post-processing workflow `cross_pollinate.py` that takes the raw high-resolution transparent PNGs from completed coloring books, automatically packages them into ZIP files for digital craft sellers (Etsy/Cricut), and generates Redbubble-optimized 5000x5000px PNGs.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Triples the number of digital storefront assets generated from a single AI generation run.
